edits.name: Wrap native scenario selector for decorative contrast arrow
Keep actual focus inset and define decorative selector wrapper
edits.before: [data-dissection-root] .diss-scenario-console :is(button, select):focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1766d2; outline-offset: -5px; box-shadow: none; }

edits.name: Keep high contrast scenario name wrapping with currentColor chevron
edits.after:
[data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console select { appearance: none; padding-right: 2.25rem !important; }
[data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console__select-wrap::after { display: block; }

edits.name: Keep forced color scenario name wrapping and actual focus cue
edits.before:
[data-dissection-root] .diss-scenario-console select { appearance: auto; }
  [data-dissection-root] .diss-scenario-console :is(button, select):focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight !important; }
